post.photo: A tablet face down on the arm of a sofa, late afternoon light, a child's shoe or a cup beside it. No people, no faces, no child. 1080 x 1350. Take it Sunday evening or Monday before 09:30.
post.instagram:
Five o'clock. The tablet goes off. The mood of the whole house goes with it.

That was the afternoon we did not see coming. It had not really come up with our first. With our second, YouTube and screens turned into a battle, and not only a battle about screens. How the handover went decided how the whole evening went.

Anyone who has taken a tablet off a small child at five in the afternoon knows the exact feeling.

We did not think the screen was evil. We just noticed that the way the time ended mattered more than the time itself.

That was the start of the question we ended up building an answer to.

What does the handover look like at your house?
